comparator.name: Notarial Law
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027 first year; adopted 2027–2028 curriculum for second and third years of the Fall 2026 cohort
comparator.sourceNotes: OER 2026–2027, Article 11.3, prescribes 60 EC in each year. For an entrant in 2026–2027, use its first-year list and its separately published 2027–2028 second- and third-year lists, consistent with its Article 15.2 transition rule. All components are compulsory: Article 12 explicitly provides no free elective or minor space; Article 10.2 lists no formal specialization. The first-year PPI strand is embedded in Juridische vaardigheden and the second-year PPI strand in Bestuursrecht, not separately credited. The bachelor thesis is 6 EC. The prospectus likewise identifies these changed later-year lists; future schedules are subject to subsequent regulations.
components: Includes the compulsory first-year PPI strand and language assessment, not separately credited.

exception.reason: This wholly compulsory Dutch notarial-law bachelor builds a sustained legal sequence in property and real-estate ownership, obligations and contracts, inheritance, family and matrimonial property, company law, taxation, procedural law, notarial professional practice and a legal thesis. UCR offers a broad law foundation and individual courses in private, corporate, criminal, constitutional, European and international law. It has no sequence in Dutch inheritance, notarial property, matrimonial-property or tax law and no notarial practice or Dutch legal drafting. A 24-course UCR closest match would have to fill much of its curriculum with adjacent economics, politics or general philosophy and would misrepresent those missing professional legal fields as notarial training.
exception.curriculumContext: The adopted 2026–2027 OER expressly prints the revised second- and third-year curricula beginning in 2027–2028, which apply in principle to the 2026–2027 entry cohort. This 180-EC reconstruction combines the prescribed 2026–2027 first year with those prescribed revised later-year lists. No free electives, minor space or formal graduation track is specified.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Checked the current main-branch data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx (151 course rows), including names, course profiles, descriptions and scheduled terms. GOSGATE102 introduces law and property/torts; GOSLAWJ311 addresses contract and tort obligations; BENBUSI311 addresses cross-border contracts, corporate and business law; GOSLAWJ211/212/213/312 cover criminal, public international, constitutional and EU law. BENBUSI112 addresses accounting, BENLEAD312 negotiation and BENECON111 economic concepts. None teaches a sustained Dutch notarial-law sequence in inheritance, relationship property, conveyancing/real estate, tax, notarial professional duties, legal drafting or the specialist civil-law procedure that dominates the VU curriculum. The nearest 24-course palette would therefore rely on adjacent business, political and general normative courses rather than a defensible notarial core.
